destinations.name: Larabanga Mosque
destinations.description: The oldest mosque in Ghana, dating back to the 15th century. Built in the Sudanese architectural style with distinctive mud and stick construction. A significant Islamic heritage site and national monument.
destinations.accessibility: Easy access, near Mole National Park entrance
destinations.location_details: Larabanga village, 5km from Mole National Park entrance. Can be combined with Mole visit.

destinations.name: Mognori Eco-Village
destinations.description: Community-based eco-tourism village on the edge of Mole National Park. Offers canoe safaris on the Mole River, traditional village experiences, and wildlife viewing from a unique river perspective.
destinations.best_time_to_visit: November to April (dry season for wildlife)
destinations.accessibility: Accessible by car, 20km from Mole Park entrance
destinations.location_details: Mognori village, near Mole National Park. Book canoe tours in advance.

destinations.name: Salaga Slave Market and Wells
destinations.description: Historic slave market town that was a major trading hub during the transatlantic slave trade. Features the original slave wells where captured people were kept, as well as the market grounds and historical monuments.
destinations.accessibility: Accessible by car, mostly flat terrain
destinations.location_details: Salaga town, Northern Region. 2-3 hours from Tamale.

destinations.name: Tamale Cultural Centre
destinations.description: Hub for Northern Ghanaian arts, crafts, and cultural performances. Features exhibitions, craft shops, and occasional traditional music and dance performances. Great place to learn about Northern culture.
destinations.location_details: Central Tamale, Northern Region. Easy to combine with city exploration.

accommodations.name: Gariba Lodge
accommodations.description: Comfortable lodge in Tamale offering clean accommodations with good amenities. Popular with tourists heading to Mole National Park.
accommodations.additional_info: Good stopover for Mole National Park trips. Can arrange tours.

accommodations.name: Mognori Eco-Village Guesthouse
accommodations.description: Community-run eco-lodge offering basic but comfortable accommodation near Mole National Park. Authentic village experience with locally prepared meals.
accommodations.additional_info: Authentic eco-tourism experience. Proceeds support local community. Book canoe safaris here.
